extra.summary: The UOB Preferred Visa shines for online and mobile contactless spend, rewarding you with accelerated UNI$ on these everyday categories. Ideal for those spending around $1,000 monthly, it maximizes rewards on groceries, dining, and shopping via mobile payments like Apple or Samsung Pay, and online marketplaces.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: 1st Supplementary Card free, $98.10 for subsequent Supplementary Cards

our_takes.our-take: The UOB Preferred Visa shines for online and mobile contactless spend, rewarding you with accelerated UNI$ on these everyday categories. Ideal for those spending around $1,000 monthly, it maximizes rewards on public transport, groceries, dining, and shopping via mobile payments like Apple or Samsung Pay, and online marketplaces. However, factor in the 3.25% foreign transaction fee if you make frequent overseas purchases. While UNI$ can offset purchases, ensure you track your spending to avoid the hefty S$100 late payment fee.
our_takes.good-for:
For online shoppers who want increased rewards on e-commerce purchases like groceries, apparel, and entertainment subscriptions.
Good for individuals who enjoy mobile contactless payments to earn UNI$ for everyday spending on dining, shopping and public transport.
Suited for people who frequent UOB’s participating merchants and prefer using UNI$ cashback for purchases in-store.
our_takes.things-to-note:
27.8% interest rate can apply if you don't pay your balance in full and on time.
3.25% fee applies for foreign transactions, so avoid using it overseas to save money.
Late payments incur a S$100 fee, so set reminders to avoid extra charges each month.
